title: Stage 11 — Dans1 build 5dfc922f097f: production and Windows-native QA of wave 3, promotion held on native shutdown
platform: Frozen Dans1 build (High/16, seven sequential gates) · production preview 127.0.0.1:8096 at desktop 1280x800 / 1440x900 and tablet 1024x768 · isolated Windows-native executable (WebView2, CDP 9281, not installed) at 2560x1370 · isolated agent-browser profiles
summary: The wave-3 tree (protected project saves, source-sheet lifecycle, bounded supplier-search contract, hardened live assistant) was frozen, built on Dans1 and exercised on the production bundle and on the Windows-native executable. All seven build gates passed (287 focused tests); the executable and 214 web artifacts are hash-verified and the served bundle carries the build ID. Production journeys for saves, sheets and pricing passed on desktop and tablet; the hardened assistant layout and guardrails passed; one user-authorized image message was answered by the real provider. Native journeys passed for saves, sheets, pricing (correct 'unavailable in this build' state with an unchanged seeded price book), the live image reply and the hardened assistant scenario. Two older assistant-layout scenarios are stale for this build and were superseded without editing any assertion; the native two-tab stale notice cannot be driven through CDP in WebView2 and is recorded as a platform limitation. After the extended QA workload the native app did not close gracefully within 5 s and was force-stopped, so the verified-build pointer is unchanged; this repeats the open shutdown issue from 8 September.
